Home/Online consultations

Online consultations

Online Therapy and Telepsychiatry in India

Direct answer: Online therapy or telepsychiatry may be possible for some people and concerns, but suitability is decided case by case under applicable telemedicine requirements.

Mind Grace provides information to help you decide what to ask about next. Diagnosis, suitability, treatment, and follow-up are discussed individually.

Is remote care suitable?

Some follow-up and counselling conversations may be possible remotely. Eligibility depends on identity, consent, privacy, connection, availability, clinical need, and safety.

Limits and emergencies

Remote care may require in-person review or referral. Do not use online channels for immediate danger; call 112.
